title: Omnipod and DASH tabs force closes AAPS if phone language is set to "Danish"
symptom: When the phone language is set to Danish, opening the Omnipod or DASH tabs in AAPS force closes the app, especially when the pod has less than 50 units left. Changing the phone language to English resolves the issue.
cause: The thread identifies that the crashes are caused by wrong translations in the Danish language strings, which lead to force closes when opening the Omnipod/DASH tabs.
fix: The fix is to correct the wrong translations. AAPS was updated so that wrong translations no longer cause crashes and fall back to English text, reporting issues via Crashlytics (referenced in PR #1329). Users can also work around by changing the phone language to English.
evidence_quote: Wrong translations should no longer cause crashes and should fall back to the English text and report an issue via Crashlytics. #1329
